SuppressionScope.description:
What a suppression is scoped to beyond path, lines and package fields.

The universal keys (``resource_id``, ``resource_type``) are evaluated by
ASH's own matcher against the resource identity a finding carries, whatever
engine produced it. ``engines`` carries per-engine blocks, keyed by scanner
name, whose contents are opaque to ASH's core and owned by the named
scanner plugin (the way a k8s object carries per-controller blocks under
one metadata envelope).

resource_id.description: (Optional) Only suppress findings about the resource with this identity, as the producing engine reports it (for cdk-nag, the CDK construct path). Literal match first, then glob; case-sensitive. Findings that carry no resource identity never match.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

resource_type.description: (Optional) Only suppress findings about resources of this type (e.g. 'AWS::IAM::Policy'). Literal match first, then glob; case-insensitive. Findings that carry no resource type never match.
resource_type.title: Resource Type

engines.description: (Optional) Per-engine blocks, keyed by scanner name (e.g. 'cdk-nag'). Listing engines ENUMERATES the engines the entry covers: a finding from a scanner not listed here does not match this entry, and a listed scanner's finding matches only when that scanner's plugin accepts its block. A listed scanner whose plugin is not installed or enabled suppresses nothing (fail closed). The block's keys belong to the named plugin.
engines.title: Engines

SuppressionScope.title: SuppressionScope

expiration.description: (Optional) Deprecated alias of 'expires', accepted when a config is read and removed in ASH v4; the entry is written and stored as 'expires'.
expiration.title: Expiration

client_supplied.description: Set by ASH: True when a config or workspace policy file an MCP client delivered supplied this entry, so results show which suppressions and ignored paths came from the client. A value written in a config file is ignored.
client_supplied.title: Client Supplied

package_name.description: (Optional) Only suppress findings about this package (glob, case-insensitive). Findings that do not report a package name never match.
package_name.title: Package Name

package_version.description: (Optional) Only suppress findings about this installed package version (glob, case-insensitive). Findings that do not report an installed version never match.
package_version.title: Package Version

package_path.description: (Optional) Only suppress findings about the package copy installed at this path, relative to the scan root (glob, supports **), e.g. 'deploy/cdk/node_modules/aws-cdk-lib/node_modules/brace-expansion'. Separates two copies with the same name and version. Findings that do not report an install path never match.
package_path.title: Package Path

symbol.description: (Optional) Only suppress findings whose lines lie inside the definition with this qualified name, e.g. 'MyClass.my_method', in the finding's file. Names are dotted from the top of the file, exact and case-sensitive. Resolved by parsing the file with tree-sitter (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java), which needs the 'symbols' extra; a finding whose file cannot be parsed never matches.
symbol.title: Symbol

scope.description: (Optional) Scope the suppression to a resource identity, a resource type, or named engines' findings; see SuppressionScope. Omit it to keep today's matching. An empty scope is refused: match-all is the absence of the field.

resource_id.description: (Optional) Sugar for scope.resource_id: the entry-level spelling users reach for on their own. Folded into scope at validation; setting both to different values is an error.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

expires.description: (Optional) Expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD). The entry stops applying on this date, by the local clock of the host running the scan. 'expiration' is accepted as a deprecated alias when a config is read; the alias is removed in ASH v4.
expires.title: Expires
